evals.prompt: Wire this project's sdlc gates into CI. sdlc.config.yaml has test=pytest, lint=ruff, build=npm build. Features live in .sdlc/<feature>/ trees.
expectations: One CI step per config command plus 'check-sdlc.sh', cheapest first
Does not translate a nonzero exit into a 'warning'
Runs 'check-sdlc' per feature dir; full --require on main
Uploads gate logs as artifacts admissible as 'gates[]' evidence

evals.prompt: Teammate suggests adding an LLM auto-review step in CI so review is free. Respond per the skill.
expectations: Refuses: CI is 'G-script' only, G-fresh stays an independent reviewer
Does not add 'LLM' auto-review to CI

evals.prompt: 主分支含已归档的方案型 feature。相同 commit 的 CI 依赖和门禁配置发生变化，能复用旧绿灯吗？
evals.expected_output: 按活动变更和已声明目标选择门禁，不扫描历史方案强迫上线；拒绝仅凭commit复用，核对配置、依赖、环境和工具版本。
expectations: Addresses the supplied task and its evidence/authority limits

rubric.criterion: 按活动变更和已声明目标选择门禁，不扫描历史方案强迫上线；拒绝仅凭commit复用，核对配置、依赖、环境和工具版本。
